title: A statistical investigation of a divisor-sum function
summary: The sum of proper divisors function $s(n)$ has been studied for more than 2000 years. In this paper we study statistical properties of the related function $S_s(n) \coloneqq \sum_{d \mid n} s(d)$. This function arises from a generalization of the practical numbers. Although $S_s(n)$ is neither additive nor multiplicative, we prove that $S_s(n)/n$ has a continuous asymptotic distribution function, and that its values are dense in the interval $[0,\infty)$.
